notes.title: New Game +, Screen Shot Mode are Coming! Historical 30% off！
notes.content:
[h1][b] "New Game +" and New Difficulty Level[/b][/h1]

We prepared a[b] "New Game +"[/b] mode for those players who are still longing for more after completing the first playthrough. Players can inherit [b]weapons, chips, credits, skill points, and talents[/b]. With full proficient Ann, saving the world again!

Meanwhile, the[b] "New Game +“[/b] mode also allows players to adjust the difficulty to a higher level of [b]"Hell"[/b]. For those players who would like to play relaxedly, we have also prepared[b] "Easy Mode" [/b]as well. 。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38469021/09abf5071d2f4620f28e739f18c0253a9e2bd6f3.png[/img]

[h1][b]Screenshot mode[/b][/h1]

Now, players can enter the[b] "screenshot mode"[/b] on the pause menu to hide all UI screens and shoot favorite images. Even in fierce battles, you can easily lock your amazing moments!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38469021/e52166a6b549311739166df8f6fc6ab3858474b8.jpg[/img]

[b]We have other optimizations too[/b]

Added English and Japanese multi-ending voice-over
Fixed part of the cutscene errors
Fixed some language text display errors
Optimized the AI behavior tree of some enemy soldiers
Optimized the armor value of some elites

[b]In the upcoming Steam Summer Sales， ANNO: Muationem is going on a historical discount at 30% off, opening time: June 22 0:00 to June 24 0:00 and June 24 1:00 am to July 8 1:00 am (CST) [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38469021/bcc9e816096672ed7f537c42601b78a6267add71.png[/img]

notes.title: [1.04] New ending online, new costumes and easy mode added
notes.content:
Dear players,

Thank you all for your recent support and encouragement! During this time, we've received a lot of suggestions and comments from players. All of them are really helpful!

After more than a month of struggle, we have improved the game's experience, difficulty balance and added new costumes, while also adding a more complete ending. Players who have already finished the game can also experience the new ending through the cover of the "On the Eve of an Ending".

Meanwhile, due to time constraints, the translation of some languages and English/Japanese voiceover 
 are still in progress, we will update them as soon as possible.

[h3]1.04 Update[/h3]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
1. Added new costumes

2. Added Easy Mode

3. Added new ending

3. Fixed the problem of missing avatars in some dialogues

4. Fixed the bug of the position of fighting robots in the training ground

5. Fixed the problem of inaccurate guidance.

6. Fixed the problem of misplaced points in the protection of enemy soldiers.

[h3]Adjustment of balance[/h3]
1. Adjusted the speed of synthesizing items

2. Adjusted the behavior logic of some flying machines

3. Adjusted the attack point of some enemy soldiers

4. Adjusted the display of enemy HP

notes.title: [1.03.04] New frame rate adjustment function, bug fixes and optimization
notes.content:
[h3]New Features[/h3]
1. Added the option to select frame in the settings screen.

2. Chip Socket for weapons on Weapon Pack has been increased to 3.


[h3]Bug Fix[/h3]
1. Optimized the problem of infinite refreshing of drones in the first stage in the rooftop.

2. Added the aiming line of the shooting soldiers on Outcasts.

3. Optimized the problem of blocking of the enemy and the problem of invalid attacks.

4. Optimized the interactive object border after scanning, easier to identify.

13. Fixed the bounce back hint of some enemy soldiers

1. Shortened charging time of one-handed sword and Twin Blades. Adjusted the timing of interrupting some of the Ann's movements.

2. Shortened the time required for the Greatsword to charge successfully.

3. Ann can turn around when releasing the first charging attack.

4. Increase the proportion of credits and resources obtained from side quests in the first and middle of the game.

5. Optimized the behavior of the Immortal Lizard.

notes.title: Recent update plan
notes.content:
Dear mutationites! After receiving all kinds of feedback, in the next period, our update will be mainly divided into three parts bug fixes, battle experience optimization, language corrections, and adding some more plot-related content.

1. first, we will continue to fix all kinds of bugs that affect the game experience, including text errors, camera errors, collision errors, etc., which will be a more frequent process. This might be a daily update. 

2. We will also "smoothen" the combat-related experience step by step by optimizing the control of the main character, optimizing the power and special effects of weapons, optimizing the behavior of the enemy, etc., this part of the update will also be an ongoing process. 

3. A part of the quest and side quests will be added to optimize the current plot which is controversial. This part of the update will be released in the near future. This will be focusing on the end game part and won't affect the progress made by players who already finished the game

4. At the same time, we will also occasionally update some other content like clothing. We hope you will enjoy it. 

Finally, thank you very much for your feedback during this time, we still have a lot of work to do but will keep our best to take your feedback into consideration and to make ANNO: Mutationem better. 
We will try our best! Thank you!
